meta.title: FAQ: $40/mo Websites, Free Demo | Ryzon Automation
meta.description: Straight answers about pricing, the free design demo, site ownership, edits, and cancelling.

items.a: There isn’t one. Instead of a big design bill upfront, you pay a simple monthly plan. We design your demo first, for free, so you see exactly what you’re getting before you pay anything.
Yes. Right now every plan is $0 upfront. This is a limited-time offer.
The Starter Website plan includes a professional website, SEO optimization, and analytics. Growth and Complete add automations, tracking, custom design, and lifetime changes.

items.q: Is there a discount for paying yearly?
items.a: Yes. Pay yearly and you get 2 months free on every plan. Starter is $400/year instead of $480.

items.q: How long does the demo take?
items.a: Your demo can be ready as soon as the next day after you send the form.

items.q: What if I don’t like it?
items.a: Then you don’t pay anything. The demo is free with no commitment. If you’d like to see a completely different design to make up your mind, just ask. Other changes start once you pick a plan.

items.q: Can I ask for changes to my demo?
items.a: Once your demo is sent, changes start when you pick a plan. If you want to see a completely different design before you decide, just ask.

We own and manage the site for the first year. After that, if you decide to leave, we export your site files and deliver them to you to manage. If you cancel before the first year is up, the design files are not included.
Yes, anytime. If you cancel before your first year is up, the design files are not included. After the first year, we export your site files and deliver them to you.

Yes. On the Complete Package, changes and additions are free for the life of your site. On Starter and Growth, edits are handled per project: simple tasks may be free depending on how long you’ve been with us, and everything else is quoted at $20/hour, well below typical agency rates.

items.q: Do you work with businesses outside Michigan?
items.a: Yes. We work with small businesses nationwide.
